VBO:0201396.summary: Water Dog is a group name used by the FCI for breeds including the Barbet, Portuguese Water Dog and Lagotto Romagnolo. Their work differs: the Lagotto’s registry history traces a change from marsh retrieving to searching for truffles.
VBO:0201396.shortDescription: An FCI category including Barbet, Portuguese Water Dog and Lagotto Romagnolo, whose work now includes truffle hunting.

sources.title: FCI: Group 8 nomenclature
sources.evidence: Section 3 names Barbet, Irish Water Spaniel, Lagotto Romagnolo, Portuguese Water Dog, Spanish Water Dog, Wetterhoun and American Water Spaniel.

sources.title: FCI Standard 298: Lagotto Romagnolo
sources.evidence: Current PDF dated 02.10.2026 with official valid standard 08.09.2026: page 2 classifies in Section 3 Water Dogs, gives truffle-dog utilisation, and describes earlier marsh retrieving around Comacchio/Ravenna followed by truffle work after marsh drainage. Scope and morphology sections read; no claim of comprehensive comparison with the previous standard.
